G3_enumeration_cost.method: For each C1 (label-containment) query the BDP-expressible superset is that query with the label predicate removed. Historical result sizes cannot be recovered, so superset SHAPES are counted exactly and their sizes are measured against one present-day store as a proxy.

present_day_store_proxy.caveat: one store at one time; queries in the corpus ran against several rigs whose collection sizes differ

deviations_from_preregistration.registered: resolve session ids through gc session logs, run from the orchestrator rig root
deviations_from_preregistration.actual: enumerated transcript JSONL directly from the on-disk agent project directories (9,172 files, 6.8 GB)
deviations_from_preregistration.direction: larger denominator than the registered procedure would yield

deviations_from_preregistration.registered: a batched model pass over free-text search arguments
deviations_from_preregistration.actual: not run. The mechanical rule assigns N1 to EVERY non-ID-like positional argument, which is the assumption most favorable to the 'a search predicate is needed' conclusion. G1 is therefore an upper bound on the text-search residue, and it still lands below the profile-adequate threshold. A model pass could only lower it.
deviations_from_preregistration.direction: conservative against the study's own null result

deviations_from_preregistration.actual: queries carrying no predicate at all are reported as E_NONE rather than folded into E1. They remain expressible (the empty selector matches the whole collection) and no gate keys on this split.
deviations_from_preregistration.direction: reporting granularity only; no gate affected

classifier_defects_found_and_fixed: bd dep add/remove counted as reads (dep is a read subcommand only for list/tree/show/graph/why/path/cycles)
the id pattern rejected multi-hyphen ids such as agent-diagnostics-4w02, sending 1,489 identity fetches to 'unparseable'
--help invocations were classified as retrieval queries (612 of them)
shell redirection tokens (2>&1) were read as argv placeholders, which at one point discarded 27,939 of 31,133 rows
--search, --unassigned and --mol were absent from the flag table
